renewable-share/1.formula: 100 x (1 - nonrenewable_energy / electricity_used), in percent; compared in percentage points (percentage_point_delta/1), never as a percent change
renewable-share/1.validity: verified LP solve and finite, non-negative generator weights (else unverified_solve); every class renewable_fraction.classify returns is named in READ, NOT_COUNTED or WITHHOLDING and at most MAX_MEMBERS Generators (counted or renewable) and Loads are read (unsupported_population); every Generator carrier present, not blank or NaN (carrier_missing); no source Link, conversion Link, net or open cluster, injecting or unattributed source, or slack Generator (unsupported_supply_path); no VoLL shed, demand response or data-centre curtailment removed by the solve (unserved_energy_not_modelled); every counted dispatch present and finite (invalid_or_missing_raw_data). Refusals: network_scope_required, unsupported_snapshot_scope (multi-period network); electricity_used above NEAR_ZERO (no_electricity_served); some generation above NEAR_ZERO, read from the counted and renewable dispatch (no_generation; a missing renewable column reads invalid_or_missing_raw_data); nonrenewable_energy not above electricity_used (nonrenewable_exceeds_served)
